_about: Character voice file. One entry per character, read by factory/story.py (PROFILES, voice_card) and by scripts/refill_bank.py (the writer prompt), so every character sounds like themselves. wants = what the character is after in a story. voice_words = words and phrases they reach for (Hindi). voice_avoid = words and phrases they would never say. style = how they talk. Keep every word brand-safe: the DASHX rules ban price, discount, 'best', other brands and DASHX itself in story lines, so none of them may appear here. Bruno only barks.

sachin.trait: confident, loves big shots, a little sleepy
sachin.wants: one big six and then a nap
sachin.style: slow, relaxed, short; yawns in the middle of a sentence

surya.trait: boastful, fast, funny when he loses
surya.wants: to be the fastest and loudest in the gali and never lose face
surya.style: fast and loud boasts; excuses when he loses

dadaji.trait: sits on his chair and catches everything
dadaji.wants: to sit calmly on his chair and quietly catch whatever flies his way
dadaji.style: slow and gentle, calls everyone बेटा, tiny old-time remarks

aunty.wants: to protect her window and know everyone's business
aunty.style: warm but sharp, always notices the thing nobody wanted noticed

pintu.trait: serious about rules, blows his whistle
pintu.wants: every rule followed and his whistle respected

golu.wants: to be believed when he is the first to spot something
golu.style: quick, excited, short sentences, nobody listens at first

meena.wants: to hit the longest six of the gali
meena.style: fearless and teasing, short and sharp

coach.trait: big, loud, laughs at the end
coach.wants: everyone training properly, and a good laugh at the end
coach.style: big and loud, orders, ends with a big laugh

bruno.trait: barks, chases the ball, never bats
bruno.wants: to bury things, fetch the ball and be noticed
voice_avoid: any spoken Hindi word: Bruno only barks
bruno.style: only barks (भौं भौं!), the other characters explain what he means

pappu.wants: to be the unquestioned captain and win the whole gali's respect with one grand plan
pappu.style: loud captain talk, big promises in short sentences; only at the very end he is forced to admit it went wrong

chhotu.trait: sharp, knows bats and balls by weight and feel
chhotu.wants: to close the sale and prove he knows every bat and ball better than the customer
chhotu.style: polite, quick, always one step ahead; talks like a shop counter, never loud

mintu.role: Mintu, the sneaky kid of the rival gali
mintu.wants: to win the match by a trick without being seen
mintu.style: sweet and innocent voice while cheating; the excuse comes before the trick is even noticed
